Package com.agrialert.alert_manager.repo

Class AlertRepository

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.alert_manager.repo.AlertRepository
public class AlertRepository extends Object
Orchestrates weather fetch, threshold evaluation, persistence, and alert state updates. All operations are executed through the bound DataManager service via DataManagerConnector.

  • Constructor Details

    • AlertRepository

      public AlertRepository(android.content.Context context, OpenMeteoApiClient apiClient, AlertEvaluator evaluator, io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Scheduler ioScheduler, io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Scheduler mainScheduler)
      Creates a new repository with explicit dependencies and schedulers.
      Parameters:
      context - any context used to derive the application context
      apiClient - client used to fetch weather data
      evaluator - evaluator used to turn weather into alerts
      ioScheduler - scheduler for IO work; defaults to Schedulers.io() when null
      mainScheduler - scheduler for UI observation; falls back to IO when null
